classification: Public industry-profile constructor and validation disagree on a representable scale/evidence aggregate
relationship: A successfully constructed private-backed industry profile should obey the same scale restrictions enforced by its own validation and decoder.
source_counterexample: InferredIndustryProfile::new(vec![IndustryEvidence::Derived(DerivedIndustry::PeatCutting(PeatCuttingIndustry{scale:ProductionScale::Regional}))]) returnsSome: nonempty,len1,no duplicate. Calling validate on that exact returned value rejects at2186..2187 because regional peat cutting is outside the model. Serializing then manually Serde decoding also rejects through validate at2241.
actual_path: Source-only supported public constructor→returned private-backed aggregate→public validation/manual decoder mismatch. All individual enum payloads are representable; this is an API/admission contract inconsistency, not an observed world-import failure. Actual canonical infer_industries caps peat scale toLocal at2479, so that ordinary inference producer is not alleged bad.
